author: a. j. sheridan
title: Rosa DeLauro criticizes Trump administration's economic policies and approach to Iran deal
text:
Rosa DeLauro, a U.S. Congresswoman representing Connecticut’s 3rd district since 1991, has recently used her social media platform to criticize economic and foreign policy decisions made by the Trump administration.
On June 15, 2026, DeLauro posted: “A trillion dollars for one man. Pink slips for thousands of federal workers. Empty refrigerators and skyrocketing gas prices for millions of families. This economy is rigged for the wealthy and steals from working and middle-class families.”
Two days later, on June 17, she commented on former President Trump’s handling of the Iran Nuclear Deal: “President Trump tore up the Iran Nuclear Deal and its tough nuclear inspections. His “deal”? $300B and total sanctions relief. He launched this war with no plan and is now racing to end it on any terms – leaving Iran with more control than under the deal he destroyed.”
Later that same day, DeLauro shared another post referencing Republican lawmakers: “republicans rn https://t.co/eQReSVGvCq https://t.co/d6ZMICui08” .
DeLauro has represented Connecticut’s 3rd District in Congress since replacing Bruce Morrison in 1991. She was born in New Haven, Connecticut, in 1943 and continues to reside there at age 80. DeLauro graduated from Marymount College, Tarrytown, in 1964 with a Bachelor of Arts degree.
